_comment: Environment Cards (rulebook 5.4.1). Each is the size of one Large Grid and is placed ON the board to give that Grid a special effect. Text transcribed from the publisher's own English card scans, which is why there is no zh here: these were read off the English printing directly rather than translated from Chinese.
_source: English card scans, 'Obsidian Protocol/Cards/Environment Cards'. Rules text from the rulebook's own 5.4.1.
_placement: If Environment Cards are used, the two players place them alternately while setting up the battlefield. The total may not exceed the number printed on the Battlefield (Layout) Card, which is 4 on every 12x12 layout scanned so far: Alley, Hot Zone, Steelworks. They generally cannot be placed on Tactical Zones.
_unmodelled: Nothing here is wired into the board yet. This is reference data only.

cards.name: Abyss
cards.text: Ground Units cannot voluntarily enter this Grid. If a Ground Unit enters this Grid due to Forced Movement, the Unit is immediately Destroyed.

cards.name: Anti-gravity
cards.text: When a Ground Unit performs Movement originating in this Grid, the Movement Type is Flying.

cards.name: Fragile Platform
cards.text: When a Ground Unit enters this Grid, its Movement ends immediately and this Card is removed.

cards.name: High Temperature
cards.text: When a Unit enters this Grid, it gains 1 Fragile Token.

cards.name: Rugged
cards.text: Ground Units require 1 additional Movement Range to exit this Grid.
